company.name: Karmen
company.shortDescription: Karmen is a fintech offering online non-dilutive funding for growth, working capital, and invoice factoring to digital businesses.
company.description: Karmen offers non-dilutive financing solutions that enable digital businesses to access capital quickly and flexibly. The platform allows companies to secure funds for various needs, such as customer acquisition, recruitment, and inventory financing, with a streamlined online process.

productsAndServices.description: A short-term loan product offering financing from 1 to 24 months with funds delivered within 48 hours through a fully online process, without processing fees or guarantees.
productsAndServices.name: Karmen Short-term Loan

productsAndServices.description: A factoring solution that finances B2B customer invoices without requiring the transfer of receivables, allowing businesses to maintain control over client relationships while receiving funds within 48 hours.
productsAndServices.name: Karmen Factor

productsAndServices.description: A non-dilutive financing model where companies receive capital upfront in exchange for a percentage of future revenues, with repayments adjusted based on monthly performance.
productsAndServices.name: Revenue Based Financing (RBF)

productsAndServices.description: A financing service that allows businesses to pay suppliers immediately while preserving their cash flow by accessing funds quickly.
productsAndServices.name: Supplier Payment Financing

productsAndServices.description: A financing solution that provides funds within 48 hours to finance company stock, with repayments aligned to sales performance.
productsAndServices.name: Inventory Financing

productsAndServices.description: A financing option to fund marketing and customer acquisition campaigns, with repayments linked to the return on investment generated by these campaigns.
productsAndServices.name: Marketing Budget Financing

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Debt Financing round raised $58,209,996, or 23.17% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $17,964,430 to $162,481,363, a 9.04x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 67 (-5 over 90 days) and market heat at 55 (-5).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
